ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what does the proboscis monkey consume?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there is a food web schematic diagram, with a box labeled "Proboscis Monkey" in the upper right and a box labeled "Mangrove Forests" in the lower right. An arrow points from "Mangrove Forests" to "Proboscis Monkey". According to the fact that arrows in a food web usually indicate the flow of food or resources to the consumer, the arrow pointing into Proboscis Monkey indicates that it consumes the object from which the arrow originates. Therefore, what the proboscis monkey consumes is mangrove forest.
